title: Diabetes-Prediction
summary: A Jupyter Notebook project that predicts diabetes from a tabular health dataset, using synthetic oversampling to address class imbalance in the training data. It calls SDV's CopulaGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) with a SingleTableMetadata schema to generate synthetic rows for balancing, and also carries an in-tree data_transformer.py that imports rdt.transformers directly.
evidence: gan.ipynb:867-1252 'from sdv.single_table import CopulaGANSynthesizer' with SingleTableMetadata and execute_result output
needs: gan/data_transformer.py appears to be a vendored copy of ctgan's internal transformer (imports rdt.transformers directly); unclear whether it is actually invoked or just dead code alongside the SDV notebook calls.
